name: apstats-live-worksheet
description: AP Statistics live worksheet with AI grading and class aggregation

scripts.gitnexus:analyze: node scripts/gitnexus-shadow.mjs && GITNEXUS_MAX_FILE_SIZE=4096 npx gitnexus analyze --force
scripts.pull-summaries: node -e "require('fs').existsSync('../algebra2-live-worksheet/scripts/pull-class-summaries.mjs')||(console.error('pull-summaries: ../algebra2-live-worksheet not found (the a2-live-worksheets checkout must sit next to follow-alongs)'),process.exit(1))" && node ../algebra2-live-worksheet/scripts/pull-class-summaries.mjs --course apstats --out roster-local/class-summaries
